technical.summary: LMT shows mixed technicals with solid trend structure (price above all MAs, supertrend bullish) but lacks momentum confirmation; overbought stochrsi, negative MACD, weak ADX, and negative CMF create headwinds despite bullish OBV—moderate risk swing entry with caution on momentum divergence.

fundamental.summary: LMT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contract wins, and no lobbying activity; earnings in 14 days present timing risk with minimal fundamental conviction.

sentiment.summary: Three recent congressional sales (74-81 days old) show weak conviction; fear sentiment (37) presents contrarian opportunity but lack of news data and neutral AAII prevent strong directional conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (397), flat yield curve signals recession risk, earnings event in 14 days compounds volatility exposure for LMT.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with supertrend bullish and rising OBV volume provides structural uptrend confirmation in a fear-zone contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: VIX crisis levels (397), earnings event in 14 days, negative MACD/CMF distribution signals, weak ADX trend strength, and price below DEMA/TEMA create compounding macro and technical headwinds that outweigh bullish structure.

decision.entry_rationale: While price structure above major MAs and supertrend bullish offer technical support, VIX crisis levels (397) combined with earnings in 14 days create unacceptable macro and event risk that outweighs moderate technical setup.
decision.primary_risk: VIX at crisis levels (397) and earnings event within 14 days will amplify volatility; negative MACD/CMF distribution signals suggest institutional selling despite bullish price structure.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias despite technical bullishness
decision.portfolio_note: Already 43 positions in Industrials sector; adding LMT increases concentration risk during macro stress without fundamental or smart money conviction.
